title: As a reservist officer in army, my favorite getup is a black tshirt, a cargo pants, a rifle and a side arm pistol.... now as i became a soldier for an army of God, nothing change but instead of rifle, it became a laptop and instead of a sidearm pistol, it became a phone with a bible installed on it.... the mission is still the same, go and defend for adversaries and equip others to fortify. Now, as we have been doing bible study and cellgroup here at weegols Garden, more became ready and been changed their lives toward God and willing to go for discipleship.
paragraphs: As a reservist officer in army, my favorite getup is a black tshirt, a cargo pants, a rifle and a side arm pistol.... now as i became a soldier for an army of God, nothing change but instead of rifle, it became a laptop and instead of a sidearm pistol, it became a phone with a bible installed on it.... the mission is still the same, go and defend for adversaries and equip others to fortify. Now, as we have been doing bible study and cellgroup here at weegols Garden, more became ready and been changed their lives toward God and willing to go for discipleship.
Once again, thanks to my cousin Jeremiah Betia Calo for letting me use his facility and his staff for the advancement for God's kingdom.God bless you with more opportunities and blessings gaw.
All for the glory of God and advancement of His Kingdom.
